function.name: report_statement
function.description: State the one thing a person must know to answer the task well.

verdict.description: stated when you can say it; unsure when you cannot tell what answering well requires

statement.description: The one thing, in one short line. One demand only — never two joined by 'and'. One declarative sentence about the subject: a claim that is true of it — never a command, never a topic label, never a sentence about a learner (no 'know', 'understand', 'recognize', 'be able to', 'how to'). Built only from what the task and answer contain: no examples, no parentheses, no code, no mention of the task or the passage, and no ordering borrowed from the source (no 'first', 'second', or 'main' anything). Required with stated.

reason.description: Why you cannot tell, in one sentence. Required with unsure.
